title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Maya Singh
ci_checks: docs-link-checker: failed on first run, rerun passed

description: Adds a set of RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts for Python and TypeScript, plus documented examples and docs site navigation updates. Motivation: provide reproducible starter templates for customers integrating RAG and multi-tool agents with Redwood's tool-calling enhancements; reduce onboarding time. Changes include: 1) new rag-agent templates under redwood-examples (python/ts) with README quickstarts and test harnesses, 2) updated docs pages that document tool-calling API surface and recommended patterns, 3) new docs-site images and a short walkthrough, 4) small CI script to verify docs links and runnable examples. Testing: included unit tests for examples, link-check CI, manual smoke tests on hosted demo. Checklist: [x] examples added and tested locally [x] docs pages written and linted [x] link-check CI added [x] reviewers addressed comments. This PR touches both examples and docs; no runtime or API breaking changes anticipated.
